note: Automatic boundaries are revisable geometric/appearance inferences, not certified crossings. Legacy score is inherited, not improvement. Online replay is rebuilt prefix-by-prefix using only arrived endpoint evidence; image features themselves remain pre-extracted. No human blind or real device validation.

coverage.note: Visual baseline association is not certified physical-region identity. Temporal/new-region proposals do not count as verified coverage.

temporalOrganization.note: Provisional temporal organization does not count as physical region coverage

relationChanges.note: Consistency is not correctness. Unknown-to-supported changes and repairs are distinguished; final offline scores cannot replace this trace.

historicalObjectRetrieval.note: Null when no object annotations; observation facts only, no claim of current presence
